title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description: Deploy, automate, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure across core Amazon Web Services including EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, and RDS.

goal.objective: Provision and maintain secure, highly available, and scalable cloud solutions across Amazon Web Services infrastructure.
career_pillars: AWS Core Compute & Networking (VPC, IAM, EC2)

learn.summary: Master AWS networking (VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables, NAT Gateways), IAM least-privilege security, compute services, S3, RDS, CloudWatch telemetry, and automation.
key_competencies: EC2, Auto Scaling & Application Load Balancers

capstone_projects.title: Production 3-Tier Web Application on AWS with Terraform
capstone_projects.description: Provision an automated multi-AZ 3-tier architecture with public/private subnets, auto-scaling web workers, and encrypted database replicas.

capstone_projects.title: Multi-Region High-Availability VPC & ECS Infrastructure
capstone_projects.description: Provision an automated multi-region active-active architecture with latency-based DNS routing, Aurora Global Database failover, and strict IAM boundaries.

interview_focus: IAM Evaluation Logic (Explicit Deny vs Allow)
Troubleshooting High CPU / Unhealthy ALB Targets

tree.name: Foundations and Core Concepts
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable cloud foundation: master the AWS Global Infrastructure, shared responsibility security boundaries, cost allocation tags, and Linux systems administration via the AWS CLI v2.

resources.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Course 2026 (CLF-C02) — freeCodeCamp.org
Cloud Computing In 6 Minutes | What Is Cloud Computing? | Cloud Computing Explained | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

children.name: Introduction to Cloud Computing & AWS
children.description: Understand cloud computing models from an engineering perspective: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, total cost of ownership (TCO) vs capital expense (CapEx), cloud migration patterns (the 6 R's: Rehost, Replatform, Repurchase, Refactor, Retire, Retain), and the AWS Well-Architected Framework pillars.

resources.title: Cloud Computing In 6 Minutes | What Is Cloud Computing? | Cloud Computing Explained | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)
Cloud Computing In 6 Minutes | What Is Cloud Computing? | Cloud Computing Explained | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

children.name: AWS Global Infrastructure
children.description: Deep dive into AWS physical and logical architecture: Regions, Availability Zones (AZs with distinct power and networking), Local Zones, Wavelength Zones, Point of Presence (PoP) Edge Locations, and data sovereignty compliance.

resources.title: Terraform Course - Automate your AWS cloud infrastructure

children.name: AWS Account Management & Billing
children.description: Master enterprise multi-account governance and billing: AWS Organizations, Consolidated Billing, Cost Allocation Tags, AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets alerting, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), and Savings Plans vs Reserved Instances.

resources.title: Managing Your AWS Account and Billing
AWS Organizations Tutorial - Create and Manage Multiple AWS Accounts
AWS Cost Management: Billing, Budgets, Cost Explorer for Beginners

children.name: Networking Fundamentals
children.description: Master foundational networking protocols for cloud engineers: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnetting calculations, TCP three-way handshake, UDP, DNS resolution records (A, AAAA, CNAME, ALIAS, PTR, TXT), TLS/SSL handshakes, and OSI model Layer 4 vs Layer 7 traffic routing.

resources.title: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner

children.name: Linux & Command Line Basics
children.description: Master systems automation using the AWS CLI v2: configuring profiles (`~/.aws/credentials`), querying output with JMESPath (`--query`), automating administrative tasks with Bash/Python (Boto3), and managing Linux instances over SSH and SSM Session Manager.

resources.title: Linux Shell Scripting Tutorial | Shell Scripting for Beginners

tree.name: Core AWS Services & Infrastructure
tree.description: Master the core compute, networking, identity, and storage services that form the backbone of all AWS infrastructure architectures.

resources.title: AWS Tutorial For Beginners | AWS Full Course - Learn AWS In 10 Hours | AWS Training | Edureka (edureka!)
Terraform Course - Automate your AWS cloud infrastructure

children.name: Identity and Access Management (IAM)
children.description: Master AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM): principle of least privilege, IAM policies (identity-based, resource-based, permission boundaries), Service Control Policies (SCPs) in AWS Organizations, temporary credentials via AWS STS (`sts:AssumeRole`), session tags, cross-account access, and policy evaluation logic (explicit deny precedence).

resources.title: How to Get Started with Jobs for AWS IoT Device Management

children.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
children.description: Architect enterprise Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs): public, private, and isolated database subnets spanning multiple AZs, Internet Gateways (IGW), NAT Gateways (HA placement and cost optimization), Route Tables, Network Access Control Lists (NACL stateless filtering), Security Groups (stateful firewall rules), VPC Peering, Transit Gateway (TGW) hub-and-spoke networks, and VPC Endpoints (Gateway and PrivateLink Interface endpoints).

children.name: Compute Services: EC2, Elastic Load Balancing & Auto Scaling
children.description: Master Amazon EC2 compute engineering: instance families (compute, memory, storage optimized), AWS Nitro System architecture, mandating Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) with hop limit 1 to prevent SSRF credential theft, Launch Templates, Auto Scaling Groups (ASG) with dynamic target tracking and predictive scaling policies, and Spot Instance fleet allocation strategies.

resources.title: AWS EC2 Master Class - The Most Complete EC2 Course!
AWS ALB (Application Load Balancer) - Step By Step Tutorial (Part -9)

children.name: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB)
children.description: Deploy and tune Elastic Load Balancers: Application Load Balancer (ALB Layer 7 routing rules, path/host based routing, mutual TLS, target group health checks), Network Load Balancer (NLB Layer 4 ultra-low latency, static IP allocation, TCP/UDP termination), and Gateway Load Balancers (GWLB) for third-party security appliances.

resources.title: AWS ALB (Application Load Balancer) - Step By Step Tutorial (Part -9)
AWS ELB Tutorial - Application Load Balancer (ALB) Explained

children.name: Elastic Block Store (EBS)
children.description: Engineer block storage with Elastic Block Store (EBS): volume types (gp3 baseline IOPS/throughput tuning, io2 Block Express for mission-critical databases), multi-attach EBS volumes, EBS encryption using customer-managed KMS keys, lifecycle management with Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM), and Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR).

resources.title: AWS EBS Explained | Elastic Block Store Tutorial

children.name: Storage Services: Object, File & Archive
children.description: Master Amazon S3 object storage: storage classes (Standard, Intelligent-Tiering, Glacier Flexible/Deep Archive), S3 Lifecycle configurations, Cross-Region Replication (CRR) and Same-Region Replication (SRR), S3 Object Lock for WORM compliance, S3 Versioning, Bucket Policies, and Block Public Access governance.

resources.title: AWS S3 Tutorial for Beginners | Amazon S3 Simply Explained (Theory and Demo)

children.name: File Storage: EFS & FSx
children.description: Deploy shared cloud file systems: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) for POSIX-compliant multi-AZ shared storage with lifecycle tiering to infrequent access, and Amazon FSx (FSx for Windows File Server, FSx for Lustre for high-performance compute and machine learning workloads).

resources.title: AWS FSx explained | Learn in 10 minutes

children.name: Database Services: Relational, NoSQL, Caching & Data Warehousing
children.description: Architect scalable database tiers: Amazon RDS multi-AZ deployments with automated failover, read replica connection routing, and automated snapshots.

children.name: Amazon Aurora
children.description: Master Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL: decoupled storage engine with 6-way replication across 3 AZs, Aurora Serverless v2 dynamic scaling, Aurora Global Databases for cross-region read replicas and sub-second replication, and automated storage auto-repair.

resources.title: What is Amazon Aurora | Amazon Aurora Tutorial | AWS Database Services | AWS Training | Edureka

children.name: Amazon ElastiCache
children.description: Implement in-memory caching with Amazon ElastiCache for Redis / Valkey: cluster mode enabled, multi-AZ with automatic failover, read replicas, Redis keyspace notifications, cache-aside implementation, and in-transit/at-rest encryption.

resources.title: AWS ElastiCache Deep Dive for Redis and Memcached

children.name: Amazon Redshift
children.description: Architect cloud data warehouses with Amazon Redshift: RA3 node types with managed storage, columnar data storage, distribution styles (AUTO, KEY, ALL, EVEN), sort keys, Redshift Serverless, and data sharing across accounts.

resources.title: AWS Redshift Explained: What is Amazon Redshift?

children.name: Serverless Computing: Lambda & API Gateway
children.description: Build enterprise event-driven serverless architectures: AWS Lambda (execution environment lifecycle, provisioned concurrency, SnapStart for Java, VPC ENI attachment, dead-letter queues), Amazon API Gateway (REST vs HTTP APIs, throttling, usage plans, authorizers), and AWS Step Functions distributed workflows.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]
AWS API Gateway & Lambda Tutorial | Create a Serverless API

children.name: DNS & Traffic Management: Route 53
children.description: Master global traffic routing with Amazon Route 53: public and private hosted zones, routing policies (Simple, Weighted, Latency-based, Failover, Geolocation, Geoproximity, Multi-Value Answer), Route 53 Health Checks, and DNSSEC validation.

resources.title: AZ-900 Episode 22 | User-defined Routes (UDR) with Route Tables
AZ-900 Episode 22 | User-defined Routes (UDR) with Route Tables

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC): CloudFormation & Terraform
children.description: Automate infrastructure provisioning with Infrastructure as Code (IaC): AWS CloudFormation templates, parameters, outputs, intrinsic functions, Change Sets, and AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK v2) using TypeScript/Python to generate synthesized CloudFormation stacks.

resources.title: Learn Terraform with Google Cloud Platform – Infrastructure as Code Course
Learn Terraform with Google Cloud Platform – Infrastructure as Code Course

children.name: Terraform for AWS
children.description: Master HashiCorp Terraform on AWS: state file management with S3 backend and DynamoDB table locking, writing reusable modules, managing multi-environment workspaces, and integrating `tflint` and `checkov` security scans.

children.name: Containerization: ECR, ECS & EKS
children.description: Orchestrate containers on AWS: Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) with Fargate serverless compute, task definitions, service autoscaling, and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) managed control plane with Karpenter autoscaling and AWS IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA).

resources.title: AWS ECR, ECS, Fargate - Containers on AWS Explained

children.name: Messaging & Streaming: SQS, SNS & Kinesis
children.description: Implement asynchronous decoupled architectures: Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS standard vs FIFO queues, visibility timeout, dead-letter queues), Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS fan-out to SQS/Lambda), and Amazon EventBridge event bus with content-based schema filtering.

resources.title: AWS SQS, SNS, Kinesis Explained (Theory + Demos)

children.name: Content Delivery Network: CloudFront
children.description: Accelerate global content delivery with Amazon CloudFront: CDN distributions, Origin Shield, cache behaviors, edge lambdas (Lambda@Edge vs CloudFront Functions), custom SSL certificates with AWS Certificate Manager (ACM), and integration with AWS WAF.

resources.title: AWS VPC Beginner to Pro - Virtual Private Cloud Tutorial
AWS VPC Beginner to Pro - Virtual Private Cloud Tutorial

tree.name: Operations, Monitoring, & Automation
tree.description: Ensure enterprise operational excellence: full-stack CloudWatch monitoring, automated patching, distributed tracing, and compliance auditing.

resources.title: CloudWatch vs CloudTrail vs X-Ray | AWS Monitoring Tools Explained in 5 Minutes
AWS Systems Manager Tutorial | What is SSM? Run Command, Patch Manager, Session Manager

children.name: Observability & Monitoring: CloudWatch, CloudTrail & X-Ray
children.description: Master cloud observability with Amazon CloudWatch: metric alarms, CloudWatch Logs Insights query syntax, custom embedded metric format (EMF), and CloudWatch Synthetics canaries for continuous endpoint health verification.

resources.title: Monitoring, Logging, and Auditing on AWS: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and X-Ray

children.name: Distributed Tracing: AWS X-Ray
children.description: Implement distributed application tracing with AWS X-Ray: active tracing instrumentation, service map visualization, tracing calls across API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, and DynamoDB, and debugging upstream latency bottlenecks.

children.name: CI/CD with AWS Developer Tools
children.description: Build continuous integration and delivery pipelines: AWS CodePipeline orchestration, AWS CodeBuild containerized testing, and AWS CodeDeploy deployment configurations (Canary, Linear, All-at-Once) with automatic CloudWatch rollback alarms.

resources.title: GitHub Actions Tutorial - Basic Concepts and CI/CD Pipeline with Docker
Deploy React App on AWS with Full CI/CD 🚀| CodePipeline, CodeBuild, S3 Static Hosting (Step-by-Step)

children.name: Security Management & Compliance
children.description: Implement defense-in-depth cloud security: zero-trust IAM policies, network isolation, infrastructure compliance auditing, and automated vulnerability scanning.

resources.title: Cyber Security Full Course for Beginner
AWS Security Best Practices - The Ultimate Guide

children.name: Threat Detection & Configuration: GuardDuty, Security Hub & Config
children.description: Deploy intelligent threat detection: Amazon GuardDuty machine learning threat intelligence (analyzing CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs, and EKS audit logs), AWS Security Hub automated CIS compliance benchmarks, and Amazon Inspector continuous container and EC2 vulnerability scanning.

resources.title: AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub & Config Explained

children.name: Network & Application Protection: WAF, Shield & Firewall Manager
children.description: Protect edge and web workloads: AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) managing rate-based rules, SQL injection and XSS rule groups, AWS Shield Advanced for managed DDoS mitigation, and AWS Network Firewall for centralized stateful traffic inspection.

resources.title: AWS WAF Explained | What is a Web Application Firewall?
AWS WAF, Shield & Firewall Manager - AWS Security & Advanced Networking Part 15

children.name: Key & Secret Management: KMS & Secrets Manager
children.description: Master cryptographic key and secret management: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) envelope encryption with Customer Managed Keys (CMKs), key policies vs IAM policies, automatic annual key rotation, and AWS Secrets Manager with automated Lambda credential rotation for RDS.

resources.title: AWS KMS - Key Management Service explained

children.name: Cost Management & Optimization
children.description: Execute FinOps cost optimization: rightsizing compute instances with AWS Compute Optimizer, leveraging Graviton ARM-based instances (saving up to 40%), analyzing S3 Storage Lens metrics, and purchasing Savings Plans and Reserved Instances.

resources.title: AWS Cost Optimization: The Complete Guide

children.name: High Availability & Disaster Recovery
children.description: Architect disaster recovery (DR) strategies: Backup & Restore, Pilot Light, Warm Standby, and Multi-Site Active-Active across AWS Regions, calculating and testing Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) with AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS).

resources.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate Full Course (SAA-C03) - Free Training

children.name: Automation & Configuration Management: Python/Boto3 & SSM
children.description: Automate cloud fleet management with Python (Boto3): authoring serverless event-driven automation for instance scheduling, automated snapshot cleanup, and security compliance auto-remediation via EventBridge rules.

resources.title: Automate AWS with Python and Boto3

children.name: AWS Systems Manager (SSM)
children.description: Master AWS Systems Manager (SSM): Session Manager for secure, port-less shell access without public IPs or open port 22, Parameter Store for hierarchical configuration management, and Patch Manager for automated OS maintenance.

resources.title: AWS Systems Manager Explained (SSM) in 10 minutes

children.name: Troubleshooting & Incident Response
children.description: Troubleshoot complex cloud incidents: analyzing VPC Flow Logs with Athena, debugging EC2 launch failures and status checks, diagnosing IAM permission denials using CloudTrail `dry-run` and error codes, and resolving Lambda timeout and cold-start spikes.

resources.title: AWS CloudWatch Deep Dive - Learn to Monitor Your AWS Infrastructure

tree.name: Project Work & Career Readiness
tree.description: Build enterprise-grade cloud projects, prepare for AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator certifications, and master cloud systems architecture interviews.

Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer Course [2025] - Pass the Exam!

children.description: Portfolio Project 1: Build a Highly Available, Fault-Tolerant Multi-Tier Web Architecture on AWS: multi-AZ VPC, Auto Scaling Group with EC2/ALB, Aurora PostgreSQL database, Route 53 failover, CloudFront CDN, and complete provisioning with Terraform.

resources.title: Deploy a Scalable React App to AWS Elastic Beanstalk (freeCodeCamp.org)
AWS CI/CD Project - Deploy React App with CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy to S3 & CloudFront (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.description: Portfolio Project 2: Engineer an Event-Driven Serverless Microservice Platform: API Gateway, AWS Lambda with Python/Node.js, DynamoDB single-table design, SQS/SNS event fan-out, Cognito JWT authentication, and automated CI/CD deployment via GitHub Actions.

resources.title: Build a Serverless API with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB

children.name: Case Study & Documentation
children.description: Author a Cloud Architecture Case Study: document the migration of a legacy monolithic application to a containerized microservices platform on Amazon EKS, analyzing architectural decisions, cost reductions, high availability metrics, and security compliance.

resources.title: Crafting Effective Case Studies for Your Portfolio

children.name: AWS Certification Preparation
children.description: Prepare for AWS Certifications: focused study for AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (SAA-C03) or SysOps Administrator Associate (SOA-C02), mastering scenario-based questions, exam time management, and hands-on lab exercises.

resources.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate Course

children.name: Interview & Career Strategy
children.description: Excel in cloud engineering technical interviews: whiteboard cloud architecture design (scalability, security, resilience, cost), troubleshooting broken infrastructure live, and articulating trade-offs between serverless, containers, and virtual machines.
